name: Hardboiled Noir
description: First person, raining, nobody is clean

ja.description: 雨の街、一人称、誰も潔白ではない

verbs: The stack trace smelled like rain
Somebody lied in this diff
It was a Tuesday kind of bug
The logs kept their mouths shut
Every function had an alibi
The nil came in through the back
Nobody in this repo is clean
I lit a cigarette and waited
They said the build was fine
The tests were paid to look away
I followed the pointer downtown
It dead-ended in a null
The cache had been wiped clean
Third floor, no lift, no docs
Somebody's been here before me
The commit message was a lie
Money always leaves a trace
I knew the type - a singleton
The city never frees its memory
Rain on the window, no signal
I found it where I left it
Case closed. Nobody thanked me
